name: geoneural-web
description: Browser front end for GeoNeural: terrain viewer, rate chart, landscape lab and codec views.

scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:landscape && npm run wasm:gnc
scripts.wasm:landscape: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build ../native/landscape-wasm --target web --release && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.wasm:gnc: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~ -C target-feature=+simd128" wasm-pack build ../native/gnc --target web --release --out-name gnc_wasm && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
